releases.name: Yotsuba Shader 0.9.5
releases.author: KMemphis
releases.body:
Fixes plugin updates that failed on normal connections.

- Plugin downloads no longer have a 30 s total timeout. A download only fails after 30 s without receiving data, and it retries up to 3 times. Before, the 97 MB ShadowDusk.HLSL package was cancelled, the CLI kept an old plugin and generated GLSL without the GL_EXT_gpu_shader4 prelude, which fails to compile on macOS OpenGL 2.1 for SV_VertexID shaders.
- The CLI now logs what it does while it installs or updates a plugin: the version change, each package with its size, and the percent, MB and speed for large downloads.
- If a plugin cannot be updated and differs from the CLI version, it says so and suggests yotsuba plugin update <name>.

releases.name: Yotsuba Shader 0.9.4
releases.author: KMemphis
releases.body:
Graphics API checks: declare the graphics APIs a shader must work on with `[ShaderTargets(Target...)]` and the game engines with `[ShaderEngines(GameEngine...)]`, and the analyzer reports what each API version lacks while you type. Diagnostics come in English and Spanish. `YotsubaShader.Compiler.Metadata` arrives as a dependency of the syntax packages. See the [list of rules](https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/blob/main/docs/rules/README.md).

### Breaking changes
- The `YotsubaShaderTargets` MSBuild property is removed. Use `[ShaderTargets]` on the shader class or on the assembly.
- A shader without `[ShaderTargets]` is now checked against Vulkan 1.3 only, and problems are warnings (before, all APIs were checked).

0.9.3 was never published to NuGet (its release job failed before publishing); 0.9.4 includes everything that was in it.

## What's Changed
* Fix CS0433: reference Compiler.Metadata from Roslyn instead of linking its types by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/72


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/compare/v0.9.3...v0.9.4

releases.name: YotsubaShader 0.8.1 — First Public Release
releases.author: KMemphis
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix/semantic location allocation by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/35
* Validate [VectorComponent] indices by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/36
* Feat/vector constructors by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/37
* Name generated null constants in SPIR-V by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/38
* Complete local array support: index validation, Length and tests by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/39
* Use the declared component index for vector components by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/40
* Write SPIR-V words with explicit little-endian encoding by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/41
* Keep Uniform and StorageBuffer resources in the shader IR by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/42
* Validate SPIR-V ID references and function structure before serializing by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/43
* Validate stage interface metadata before generating SPIR-V by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/44
* Declare the capabilities and types that numeric conversions require by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/45
* Keep the unsigned value of uint parameter defaults by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/46
* Lay out uniform and storage buffers with std140/std430 offsets by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/47
* Update the shader discovery tests to the current stage API by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/48
* Add MonoGame, KNI and FNA compile targets to the CLI by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/50
* Add ShadowDusk as a submodule by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/51
* CI: restore ShadowDusk natives before building the CLI by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/52
* Backup/game engine targets by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/53
* Automatizar NuGet y CLI para seis plataformas by @KMemphis in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/55

## New Contributors
* @KMemphis made their first contribution in https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/pull/35

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KMemphis/YotsubaShader/commits/v0.8.1
